en.topic_title: Hong Kong logs 229 taxi driver offences under points system, over half involving refusal of hire
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong has recorded 229 taxi driver-related offences under a demerit points system that came into effect in 2024, with more than half involving refusal of hire, the government has said.



Hong Kong urban taxis and New Territories taxis. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. 



In a written reply to lawmaker Chris Ip on Wednesday, Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said that, as of October 2, a total of 229 taxi drivers had incurred points under the Taxi-Driver-Offence Points system.
